description: Place a print page: a fixed 1504 × 800 frame in one view with its top-left at x, y (absolute view coordinates, as layout_view's ax, ay and frames). Blocks whose centre is inside print on it; the rest go on automatic pages after the placed ones. Pages print in the order they were added within each view.

subsystem.description: Subsystem whose drill-down view this is (name or id). Omit for the project view.

name: add_page
title: Add print page
